title: The board stays on this machine unless asked, with a key you can rotate
summary: The board listens on 127.0.0.1 by default; a chantier.yaml setting opens it to the network on this machine's address found at each start (no fixed address; --host for one start), saying so in its start lines; board --new-key rotates the key (done 2026-11-21); the cookie lasts 30 days.
